prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: synthetic evaluation photograph for a person-counting camera model. Desks, 10 empty chairs, a sofa, backpacks, coats draped on chairs, a potted plant, bookshelf and laptops. ABSOLUTELY ZERO PEOPLE, no humans on screens, no posters showing people, no faces, no mannequins, no reflections of humans. Ordinary realistic furniture shapes including an empty coat on a chair. No text, no watermarks, no bounding boxes. This is an empty-room negative control.
